depends_on: stage-05-harness merged: engine/tests/native/check_results.schema.json exists and tools/summarize-check-results.py validates
stop_conditions: budget_ceiling: any write past its ceiling; report the file and the number as first written, never compact
gate_impossible: a named check cannot be made green without adding a tolerance, a fixture or a solver change -- report and stop
source_contradicted: any must_contain marker absent at its ref, or this brief contradicts EQUILIBRIUM.md or CANON.md
environment_broken: a gate green at base goes red for a reason other than the write it names
mutation_invalid: a mutant of a test-running gate that does not build, or a mutant on which its gate stays green
